_comment: AGENT-EDITABLE self-pacing. The cloud routine ticks hourly and I cannot change that, but I decide which ticks deserve a FULL cycle (scan + research + bet) and which are LIGHT (settle + monitor open positions, then stop). Set next_full_cycle_after when a full cycle would be wasted — e.g. no candidate resolves for hours, or research sources are unavailable. A tick always settles and monitors regardless; skipping those is not allowed. LIGHT ticks skip only scan+research: if resolve.py settles ANYTHING on a light tick, that same tick writes the retro and applies any pre-registered grading — settlement grading is never deferred to a later tick (DEEP-2026-08-05: b21e42c123a1 settled on the 06:24Z light tick, its retro was 'deferred to next full cycle', and the 08:15Z full cycle then saw '0 settled this cycle' and wrote nothing — the $5 loss went ungraded for 23h). DEEP-2026-08-23 addition: if a settled row is outside-view-veto or wide-spread-veto, the SAME commit as its settlement retro must extend the playbook counterfactual ledger table (new row + re-summed totals + side split) -- RETRO-20260822-1314 graded the TI VISION/Yandex veto narratively and left the table stale; a veto retro without a table edit is a violation on its face.
